question: Should OpenClaw sponsor opt-in Discord source-message subagent progress and the shared lifecycle/config contract required to support it?
rationale: Implementation quality is strong, but adding durable public configuration and a shared plugin/channel lifecycle seam is a product and compatibility choice that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Close pending sponsorship
options.body: Close this branch now and invite a reopened or refreshed PR if a maintainer later sponsors the product and API direction.

options.title: Sponsor current direction
options.body: Approve the opt-in Discord UX and shared lifecycle seam, then rebase and rerun exact-head validation before merge.

options.title: Require a generic redesign
options.body: Sponsor the user outcome but require a channel-neutral prepared progress event before accepting the Discord implementation.

recommendation.title: Close pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Close this branch now and invite a reopened or refreshed PR if a maintainer later sponsors the product and API direction.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent work spans Discord, plugin, delivery, and subagent reliability surfaces relevant to this cross-boundary decision.
